stories.title: Backlash after councillor tells Russell Brand to 'stay strong'
stories.summary: Bridgend council rejects Owain Clatworthy's comments and it stands "firmly with victims and survivors of sexual abuse".

stories.title: Festival headlined by Andrea Bocelli scraps choirs fee after backlash
stories.summary: The Land of Song Festival organisers admit they "got it wrong" and will refund individual fees paid.

stories.title: Thousands of 'off-grid' homes eligible for £250 to help with heating bills
stories.summary: Households dependent on either heating oil or LPG and are eligible for reduced council tax will benefit.

stories.title: My autistic son could be trapped in the house if we lose our disabled parking bay
stories.summary: Jack is prone to running away and has damaged neighbours' cars in the past, prompting safety fears.

stories.title: I almost died after a toothache led to sepsis and a rare heart condition
stories.summary: Doctors told Danny Ellis it was a "miracle" he was alive after his first heart surgery failed.

stories.title: 'Urgency' needed to make schools safer after paedophile head jailed
stories.summary: A report found more than 50 opportunities to stop Neil Foden had been missed.

stories.title: Teenage biker suffered severe injuries in cliffside beauty spot crash - inquest
stories.summary: The body of Filip Szwarnog-Stepien was airlifted to Ysbyty Gwynedd in Bangor, where he died.

stories.title: Sir Elton John: 'Babydoll song had me leaping around the kitchen'
stories.summary: Sir Elton tells Cardiff native and Babydoll singer Jamie Miller that he has a "huge future" ahead.

stories.title: Man asks to keep eating his food during drive-thru arrest
stories.summary: Imtiaz Ali is sentenced to six months in prison after admitting possessing nitrous oxide with intent to supply.

stories.title: Ioan Gruffudd in AI warning after fan claimed they had been in year-long affair
stories.summary: The Aberdare actor urged fans not to send money, saying "explicit and disturbing" images are "not me".

stories.title: Hut owner wins battle to keep living in off-grid home he built
stories.summary: The man has lived in the self-built hut since 2020 - but never told authorities or asked for permission.

stories.title: Roman settlement dating back 2,000 years found under new-build estate
stories.summary: The discovery of lead moulds shows Romans were producing a "wide range" of brooches at the site.
